_readme: Retrieval settings for the coach's research library. Single source of truth, read by BOTH src/lib/coach/rag (TypeScript) and backend/coach/knowledge.py (Python), the same way shared/coach/system-prompt.md is — two copies of a slang table drift within a week. Patterns are matched case-insensitively against the raw question; their words are added to the keyword query at half weight. minPassageCosine is calibrated by `npm run coach:eval`.
